text:
Alex: quick q — noticed weird behavior when stop sequences overlap with max_tokens truncation: model returns finish_reason=null and we still get logprobs array longer than tokens. Anyone seen this? Repro below.

Alex: repro:
```
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-v1', prompt='A', stop=['END','\n\n'], max_tokens=5, temperature=0.0, logprobs=5)
print(resp['choices'][0].finish_reason)
print(len(resp['choices'][0].logprobs['tokens']))
```

Maya: I saw similar — earlier change to streaming+stop handling dropped finish_reason when truncation happened. It used to be 'stop' or 'length'. Might be a reorder of stop-detection vs truncation.

Davin: is this only when the stop would occur beyond max_tokens (stop_pos > max_tokens) or when the stop token length > remaining buffer? small difference for impl.

Maya: yes typically stop_pos > max_tokens. The streaming path trims generation at max_tokens before stop-detector emits 'stop'. So finish_reason becomes null and logprobs mismatch.

Leo: also ran into a weird top_p/temp interaction: temp=0 + top_p<1 picks deterministic top set, but the stop-check runs on a different path and sometimes skips logprob collection. I added a failing unit in my branch yesterday that matches this.

Ciara: workaround for clients: set max_tokens = prompt_remaining + len(longest_stop) + 1 OR post-process by finding the first stop token in the returned text and trimming logprobs to that index. Both suck for streaming consumers though.

Ciara: API contract proposal: guarantee that finish_reason is one of 'stop'|'length'|'eos' and never null; and logprobs.tokens length must equal number of tokens up to finish (inclusive). We should add an explicit regression test for streaming + non-streaming paths.

Alex: Agreed. Can we add a small contract test in gen-params suite? Test case: temp=0 top_p=0.95, overlapping stop and max_tokens and assert finish_reason in {'stop','length'} and len(logprobs.tokens)==len(text_tokens).

Davin: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/feature/gen-param-stop-fix (draft) — fixes stop detection order and adds a unit. PTAL @Maya @Leo

Maya: looked — small nit: prefer stable enum strings for finish_reason across minor versions. Add a deprecation/compat note in API docs so clients don't rely on ad-hoc strings. Also add a streaming regression test.

deploy-bot: ci/build #2345 passed (unit + integration) :white_check_mark:

Leo: I'll add streaming test and a comment about temp/top_p combos. Also will add a changelog entry and a short note in the runtime docs about ordering guarantees.

Ciara: pinging eng-oncall to watch the next deploy? @here

Alex: Thanks y'all — moving to code review. I'll merge after green CI, streaming tests passing, and a docs note.

Davin: thx, I'll mark the PR ready and request reviews.

Maya: If anyone wants to help with the streaming test, I can pair tomorrow morning.

Leo: happy to pair.

Ciara: leaving a quick checklist in the PR: unit test, streaming test, doc note, changelog, api-contract entry.

Alex: perfect. Closing the loop here. :thumbsup:
